text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council authorize a speed limit reduction from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Hesketh Court, as the warrants are satisfied.
The North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Hesketh Court, between Sloane Avenue (north intersection) and Sloane Avenue (south intersection).
